valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E at the 12-month target date (mid-Nov 2026 + 12 months = Nov 2027, when investors price FY2028 (Oct 2028 year-end) non-GAAP diluted EPS). Listing is the US common stock, USD, no ADR conversion. Starting points: Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended 2 Aug 2026) revenue $29.6B, non-GAAP EPS $3.32, AI semiconductor revenue $16.7B; Q4 guide revenue ~$34.8B, AI $21.7B, non-GAAP operating margin ~66%; management AI revenue outlook ~$115B FY2027 and ~$230B FY2028 and 'on target to exceed $30 EPS in FY2028'; FY2027 consensus EPS ~$19.47 (24/7 Wall St., 2026-11-16). Base haircuts management's FY2028 EPS target by ~17%. Non-GAAP EPS basis; share count and net debt not independently verified (filing tables not retrievable).

bear.driver: AI ramp slips and custom-silicon margins dilute (guide already implies lower operating margin of 66%); FY2028 EPS only ~$20, roughly FY2027 consensus plus ~3%

base.driver: AI revenue grows toward but below management's ~$230B FY2028 outlook, with gross-margin dilution from systems mix; EPS ~17% below the >$30 management target

bull.driver: Management delivers its >$30 FY2028 EPS target and demand exceeding outlook is supplied

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $25 the $347.01 close implies 13.9x; the equal-weighted named-analyst target (about $569 across 5 analysts) implies 22.8x base EPS, or ~$31.6 EPS at 18x, i.e. slightly above management's FY2028 target.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $25 (7.2 pp of the close); $1 of FY2028 EPS moves it by $18 (5.2 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: AI semiconductor revenue versus the $21.7B Q4 guide and the trajectory to ~$115B in FY2027, together with non-GAAP operating margin versus the 66% guide.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 FY2026 earnings, expected around early-to-mid December 2026 (date not confirmed in sources).

analyst_notes: All five named calls are Buy/Overweight with targets of $500-$600; none is below 44% implied upside versus $347.01, a 1.4x to 1.7x multiple of the close, while the base case is $450 (+29.7%), so the analyst-minus-base gap is roughly 40+ pp, equivalent to about $6.6 more FY2028 EPS at 18x or ~22.8x on base EPS. Only Cantor's raise (525 to 600 after Q3) shows a revision; the rest are reaffirmations or an initiation in Oct 2026, all after the 2 Sep earnings release and before the stock's slide from ~$419 to $347. Not included: Rothschild & Co Redburn downgrade to Neutral with target cut to $398 from $595 (reported 13 Nov; analyst unnamed and intraday timing unverified), DA Davidson upgrade to Buy with $400 target on 27 Oct (analyst unnamed in sources), and a Seaport downgrade in April 2026. Sample is small (5 analysts), target horizons undocumented so none enters the weighted target.
